decision.basis: Subject custody held at the pinned sha256 28c85c38... and mode 0444 at both the start and the end of review, and HEAD held at 2d9488bc. All 12 distinct cited digests were recomputed from disk and every one resolves to exactly the path its label names, 0 mismatches; the 13th cited row, HEAD, was verified separately. Every live claim is independently corroborated against file 08: required-now 28, owners 32 of 32, last gate row DR-G32, DR-G22 OPEN, DR-126 OPEN, condition 2 at 5 of 32 NOT MET, condition 4 MET at 28 of 28, condition 5 last. Currency recitals are correct in both directions: leftover-join.v4 current at draft time per D-265 with non-currency confined to after this successor is recorded, v3 not current, occupancy v2 current per D-219 with v1 not current, platform-tcb leftover-join.v9 current per D-268 with v6 and v5 not current, and every cross-gate currency recital is measured. I confirmed no COORD decision after D-265 records a G22 leftover-join, so v4 is genuinely current at draft time. leftoverDesign recited as [OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING] matches the single leftoverDesign-true obligation measured in the subject, adds nothing, and is not closed. The no-cell-edit branch enumerates D-170 through D-235 and D-237 through D-270 as 34 contiguous terms with no gaps or duplicates and does not span D-236, whose exclusion is correct because D-236 recorded DR-104 SATISFIED under D-056 Class B. No identifier is invented: ten decision ids resolve to COORD headings, eight DR ids to file 08 rows, both OBL ids pre-exist, and zero advisory or finding identifiers are minted — correct, because Claude Stage A returned four unlabeled observationsNotFindings strings with no advisories field and Codex Stage A returned an empty list with zero advisories, both of which I verified in the source JSON. The draft recites the Claude observations as strings, does not recast them as objects, does not recast the Codex empty list as identifiers, and denies in terms that both reviewers' identifiers are preserved. DR-118 and DR-107 are neither recited nor flattened and their non-OPEN tokens remain live. 37 of 37 attacks refuted, 0 landed.
decision.authorityOfThisVerdict: Consent to adopt the D-271 draft as written. Confers nothing beyond it: no row is SATISFIED, DR-126 and DR-117 are not satisfied, D-056 Class A is not opened, the leftover-design of OBL-G22-FX-AUTHORING is not closed, no identifier is occupied, required-now stays 28, and docs/v2/implementation/ is not authorized.
